events.description:
Called on confirm. Return a promise to keep the question open with the confirm button pending until it settles:
it closes when the promise resolves and stays open (to retry or cancel) when it rejects.
events.name: onConfirm

events.description: Called when the question is refused: the cancel button, Escape or a press outside.
events.name: onCancel

events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description: The pressable that asks the question, usually a Button or IconButton with its own name.
props.name: trigger

props.description: The question, worded as a decision ("Delete this draft?"); it names the popover.
props.name: title

props.description: One line on what confirming does, read out with the question.
props.name: description

props.description: The confirm button's words, for example "Delete". Defaults to the catalogue's "Confirm".
props.name: confirmLabel

props.description: The cancel button's words. Defaults to the catalogue's "Cancel".
props.name: cancelLabel

props.description:
`danger` for a destructive confirm: the confirm button is red and focus starts on cancel. Defaults to `default`,
where focus starts on confirm.
props.name: tone

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.description: The side of the trigger it opens on, by reading direction. The runtime flips it when there is no room.
props.name: placement

props.description: Where along that side it lines up with the trigger. Defaults to `center`.
props.name: align
